metadata.description: Prefix for resource names. Must match the Functions deployment so the shared resources resolve.
Name of the App Service. Must be globally unique.
Registry hosting the image, e.g. orchexregistry.azurecr.io.
Container image and tag within that registry.

Key Vault secret names holding a registry token scoped to this customer.

A token per customer rather than one shared credential: it can be revoked on its own, which is what
makes withholding updates possible without touching anything else. Managed identity would avoid
credentials entirely, but the registry lives in the vendor's tenant and this app in the customer's,
so cross-tenant RBAC does not reach it.
Existing Key Vault holding the app registration secrets.
Existing Application Insights instance. Leave empty to run without it.
Runspaces serving background work — the ceiling on parallel activities.
